why_pending: A commit cannot name its own hash from inside itself. The FREEZE commit lands this pair with PENDING; a small FOLLOW-UP commit — which changes nothing but this file and WORKERS.conf's BLIND_COMMIT line — writes its own parent's 40-hex sha into BOTH places. run_cells.sh REFUSES a real cell while this reads PENDING.
what_it_gates: Every read-out of CELL_CVAR25 / CELL_CVAR50 is gated against the commit at which PREREG.md, cvar_lib.py, WORKERS.conf and the branch vocabulary were frozen. A number produced by an instrument that moved after seeing data is not a blind read.
test: test_cvar_pool.py::test_blind_commit_is_pending_or_a_40_hex_sha asserts the two agree and that the value is PENDING or a 40-hex sha, so a half-stamped pair cannot ride.
